The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Distributed Systems Testing to lead a team responsible for the quality engineering platform that enables deployment and validation of distributed systems across Canonical's cloud portfolio.

We see quality engineering as a first-class engineering practice. Our Distributed Systems Testing team ensures the performance, correctness, resilience and interoperability of Canonical cloud solutions built with technologies such as Juju, Terraform, OpenStack and Kubernetes. jobs.jobDescription:
Overview

We are hiring Quality Control (QC) evaluators for a project that spans both Search and Linguistic tasks. You will perform quality checks on initial ratings produced by evaluators—validating user intent assessment, query annotation, text classification, and multimedia (video, image, audio) reviews for relevance, accuracy, and guideline adherence. The ideal candidate combines strong language skills with sharp analytical judgment, excellent documentation and feedback skills, and familiarity with short-form video culture

What you will do

  • Audit samples of initial ratings for relevance, intent alignment, taxonomy compliance, and linguistic quality.
  • Re-rate items (double-scoring) to verify labels; resolve discrepancies and document decisions.
  • Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance) and media comprehension reviews.
  • Classify and track errors using an agreed error taxonomy; surface trends and edge cases.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to evaluators; contribute to guideline clarifications and updates.
  • Participate in and lead calibration sessions to drive inter-rater agreement.
  • Track and report QC metrics (e.g., agreement rates, accuracy, error trends) and meet QC SLAs.
  • Triage escalations, handle ambiguous cases, and ensure data integrity and compliance.
  • Use internal tools to complete, track, and submit QC tasks accurately.

Who We Are

Cross River builds the infrastructure behind the world’s most innovative financial products. Our technology and capital solutions power payments, cards, lending, and digital asset capabilities that move money safely, instantly, and inclusively — trusted by leading fintechs, enterprises, and disruptors across the globe.

Our mission is simple: to build the financial infrastructure that expands access and opportunity for all. Guided by a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and purpose, Cross River has been named one of American Banker’s Best Places to Work in Fintech year after year. Whether you’re designing code, solving regulatory puzzles, or developing strategy, you’ll join a team where innovation and integrity drive everything we do — and where your work helps shape the future of finance.
